-- Usage fixture for the LuaLS check of the kitchen-sink types: calls a hook
-- author writes against the generated classes. Every line must check clean.

---@type crap.where.Posts
local where = {
    ["or"] = { { status = "draft" }, { ["seo.meta_title"] = { contains = "SEO" } } },
    ["items.label"] = "first",
    ["content._block_type"] = "text",
    ["tags.id"] = { ["in"] = { "t1", "t2" } },
    seo__meta_desc = { exists = true },
}

local found = crap.collections.posts.find({ where = where, order_by = "-seo.meta_title" })
for _, doc in ipairs(found.documents) do
    local _title = doc.title
end

-- An explicit null clears an optional field; a group takes any subset of its
-- sub-fields; a nested row keeps its id.
crap.collections.posts.update("p1", {
    summary = crap.null,
    published_at_tz = crap.null,
    seo = { meta_desc = "only this" },
    items = { { id = "r1", label = "kept" } },
})

-- A draft save leaves required fields out.
crap.collections.posts.create({ summary = "wip" }, { draft = true })

-- Every locale at once: localized fields are per-locale tables.
local all = crap.collections.posts.find_by_id("p1", { locale = "all" }) --[[@as crap.doc_localized.Posts?]]
if all and all.summary then
    for _locale, text in pairs(all.summary) do
        local _upper = text:upper()
    end
end

local user = crap.auth.user()
if user then
    local _role = user.role
end
